translations.source: Initially operated as Gulf Concrete and Cement Products (GCCP) to secure a reliable, own-quarried aggregate supply for Lake Group's ready-mix concrete operations. The company later revamped as Gulf Aggregates with quarrying carried out at Lugoba, Tanzania.
translations.translation: Inicialmente, a empresa operou como Gulf Concrete and Cement Products (GCCP) para garantir um fornecimento fiável de agregados da sua própria pedreira para as operações de betão pronto do Lake Group. Mais tarde, passou a chamar-se Gulf Aggregates e a explorar a pedreira em Lugoba, na Tanzânia.
